questions.stem: When testing a leaf for starch, why is the leaf boiled in ethanol?

options.text: To soften the cell walls for iodine to enter
To dissolve the starch in the leaf
To remove the green chlorophyll so colour changes can be seen

questions.explanation: Boiling the leaf in ethanol removes the green chlorophyll pigment, making it easier to see the blue-black colour change when iodine solution is added to detect starch.
